title: Evidence-Based Recommendation
description: Schema for a single evidence-based recommendation for population health care management teams

domain.description: Clinical condition or social need domain

role.description: Professional role the recommendation is tailored for

implementation_guidance.description: Detailed guidance on how to implement the recommendation

expected_outcomes.description: Expected outcomes when the recommendation is implemented

target_population.description: Specific population for whom the recommendation is intended

citation.description: Citation for the evidence supporting the recommendation in JAMA/AMA style

evidence_level.description: Level of evidence supporting the recommendation

tags.description: Additional tags for filtering and categorization

last_updated.description: Date when the recommendation was last updated
